content: Dɑfidi u wɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru, Hirɑmu, Tirin sunɔ u Dɑfidi sɔmɔbu ɡɔriɑ kɑ dɑ̃ɑ ɡeɑ ye bɑ sokumɔ sɛduru kɑ dɑ̃ɑ dɑ̃kobu kɑ be bɑ rɑ kpenu dɑ̃ku, kpɑ bu nùn sinɑ kpɑɑru bɑniɑ.
Dɑfidi u tubɑ mɑ Gusunɔwɑ u win bɑndun dɑm siremɔ. Wiyɑ u mɑɑ bɑn te wɔlle suɑmɔ win tɔmbu Isirelibɑn sɔ̃.
Yen biru Dɑfidi u mɑɑ kurɔbu ɡɑbu suɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Mɑ bɑ nùn bii tɔn durɔbu kɑ tɔn kurɔbu mɑruɑ.
Berɑ Sɑmuɑ kɑ Sobɑbu kɑ Nɑtɑni kɑ Sɑlomɔɔ
kɑ Yibɑɑ kɑ Elisuɑ kɑ Elifelɛti
kɑ Nɔɡɑ kɑ Nɛfɛɡi kɑ Yɑfiɑ
kɑ Elisɑmɑ kɑ Beliɑdɑ kɑ sere Elifelɛti ɡoo.
Dɑfidi u Filisitibɑ kɑmiɑ
Ye Filisitibɑ bɑ nuɑ bɑ Dɑfidi ɡum tɑ̃re wirɔ u kuɑ Isirelibɑ kpuron sunɔ, yerɑ be kpuro bɑ seewɑ bɑ nùn wɔrim wee. Ye u nuɑ mɛ, yerɑ u sɑrɑ u dɑ u kɑ bu yinnɑ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Filisiti be, bɑ tunumɑ bɑ tɛriɑ Refɑn wɔwɑɔ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Yinni Gusunɔ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, n doo n Filisiti be wɔri? Kɑɑ mɑn bu nɔmu bɛriɑ? Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo, kon nun bu nɔmu bɛriɑ.

Mɑ bɑ seewɑ bɑ dɑ Bɑɑli Perɑsimuɔ. Miyɑ Dɑfidi u Filisiti be ɡo ɡo. Mɑ u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛn yibɛrɛbɑn wuuru ɡĩɑ nɡe mɛ nim torɑ yɑ rɑ ɡunɑ ɡĩɛ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ yɑm mi yĩsiru kɑ̃ Bɑɑli Perɑsimu.
Yerɑ Filisiti be, bɑ duki suɑ bɑ ben bwɑ̃ɑrokunu deri mi. Mɑ Dɑfidi u win tɔmbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bu nu ɡuro bu dɔ̃ɔ mɛni.
Amɛn biru, Filisiti be, bɑ kpɑm nɑ bɑ tɛriɑ Refɑn wɔwɑ mi.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Yinni Gusunɔ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, n mɑɑ doo n bu wɔri? Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, oo. Adɑmɑ ɑ ku dɑ sɔru sɔrum mɛ. A besiro kpɑ ɑ dɑ ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ dɑ̃ɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ miren sɔ̃ɔwɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ nɑɑ dɑmu dɑmusu ɡɑsu nɔɔmɔ dɑ̃ɑ wɔllɔ, ɑ yɑrimɑ. Domi nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ nun ɡbiiye n kɑ ben sɑnsɑni ye wɔri.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u kuɑ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ. U dɑ u Filisiti be ɡo ɡo sɑɑ Gɑbɑonin di n kɑ dɑ Gesɛɛɔ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u yĩsiru yɑrɑ tem bɑɑmɑ kpuro sɔɔ. Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn dɑm wɛ̃ bwesenu kpuro sɔɔ.
Dɑfidi u Yinni Gusunɔn
woodɑn kpɑkororu wɑ̃ɑ yeru
sɔɔru kuɑ
